notes.title: Unveiling the gameplay trailer of Unmasked: An Inner Journey
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=V4S_WInV7YQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We are thrilled to reveal the trailer of Unmasked: An Inner Journey! It offers you a quick glance at all 5 levels of the final game, the monsters you will encounter and the techniques you will use to defeat them. And of course, the terrifying bosses that will take you a while to beat.

You play as a manifestation of a mind fighting inner fears and painful memories. As you delve into the Craftsman’s consciousness, you will help him accept his past, ultimately finding closure.

Unmasked: An Inner Journey blends action, puzzles, and chase sequences to achieve it. You will fight creatures that eerily resemble your hero, use wind gusts and giant machines to overcome various obstacles and confront monsters that guard the deepest secrets of the Craftsman’s psyche.

Embark upon the journey through 5 distinct levels, each brought to life with beautiful artwork, immersive soundscape, and captivating music — all to find out the true meaning of yourself.


A Story That Stays With You. Experience a touching tale of a life remembered. The emotionally charged narrative is conveyed entirely through visuals, music, and character vignettes — no dialogue necessary.

A Beautiful World to Explore. Unmasked: An Inner Journey offers vividly colored, meticulously crafted levels that become windows into the Craftsman's inner world. From the shimmering beauty of a sunlit river to the cold darkness of forgotten caves, these small worlds will stay with you. 

Psychology with a Punch. Run, jump, fight, and solve puzzles that test your skills and reflexes. While Unmasked isn’t meant to be a difficult game, it still provides a satisfying challenge.

Gorgeous Music. Nothing puts you in a reflective mood quite like music. Unmasked: An Inner Journey features an original soundtrack, with tracks ranging from soothing to bittersweet, perfectly complementing the story.
